title: Ɔsoro Ahorow a Wɔapam Wɔn
intro: Ahintasɛm abɔde bi gyina adebɔ ne pow a wɔpow no ntam. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ ahantan a ɛso bi nni ne ɔsoro ahyɛde bi a wobu so koraa. Wɔn paw no ka awo ntoatoaso biara mu, na ɛbɛyɛ sɔhwɛ ma ɔkra biara a wɔawo no wɔ wiase yi mu. So wubetumi ahu daa ɔtamfo yi?
clues: Na mewɔ hɔ wɔ adeyɛ bi a ɛho hia wɔ amansan nyinaa mu, bere a wɔde dɔte hyehyɛɛ abɔde foforo na Mmɔborohunufo no Hom maa no nkwa no.
Wɔde m’ankasa fii ade biako a ɛredɛw mu na ɛbae, a ɛnte sɛ saa mfutuma abɔde no.
Wɔde ahyɛde bi maa me a misusuwii sɛ ɛwɔ me gyinabea ase.
Ahantan yɛɛ me mu ma, na mepowee denneennen sɛ medi saa ahyɛde no so.
Wɔbɛkyɛ me kɔsi sɛ wɔama me Da bi a wɔahyɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mɛdi m’atirimpɔw a wɔapae mu aka sɛ mɛdaadaa afoforo no akyi.
Meyɛ wɔn a wɔnantew asase so nyinaa tamfo a wɔabɔ no dawuru, a wɔka nnaadaa aseresɛm na wɔdaadaa wɔn fi ɔkwan tẽẽ no so.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔkae sɛ ɔyɛ nyamesom wɔ atoro so
Ɔyɛɛ sika nantwi ba bi de som
Okum ne nua no esiane ahoɔyaw nti
Ɔdii anyame murkɛsefoɔ ɔsɔretia anim wɔ Makkah

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔmaa no ahomegyeɛ kɔsi Atemmuo Da no
Wɔmenee wɔn kaa asraafo no ho wɔ po no mu
Wɔdan no akraman esiane Homeda a wobuu so nti
Abo a wɔatow afi soro ahyew no
outcome.answer: Wɔmaa no ahomegyeɛ kɔsi Atemmuo Da no

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
